ability.jaycee.great_sage.desc: A Unique skill of supreme intellect. While owned it doubles chanting speed, accelerates thought and multiplies the mastery you earn tenfold.
ability.jaycee.great_sage.mode.analytica: Press to switch the scan on or off: whatever you look at within 15 blocks (25 mastered) is analysed on screen. Shift + press switches between creatures, blocks or both.
ability.jaycee.great_sage.mode.thought_a:
The world slows;
you move faster.
ability.jaycee.predator.desc: A Unique skill that devours anything: creatures, their skills and their EP, blocks and even fluids, all stored in its Stomach.
ability.jaycee.predator.mode.predation.d: Breathe out a devouring mist for 3 s: 10 damage per bite, draining 100 magicules and a skill. A kill devours all its skills and 30% of its EP. Shift + press: choose whether it eats blocks, fluids, both or neither. Cooldown 5 s (3 s mastered).
ability.jaycee.predator.mode.analysis.de: Opens the Stomach and refines what's inside while it stays open.
ability.jaycee.predator.mode.stomach.des: Opens the Stomach: 54 slots that only you can reach.
ability.jaycee.raphael.desc: The Lord of Wisdom, the Ultimate form of Great Sage. Thought Acceleration a millionfold, complete analysis, foresight of attacks, and every spell cast instantly with less mana.
ability.jaycee.magic_perception.desc: Press to sense magicules: living things nearby glow through walls, for you alone. Costs 5 magicules a second; mastered, it reaches twice as far.
ability.jaycee.self_regeneration.desc: On once learned. While hurt you regenerate 2 HP a second for 100 magicules every 5 seconds; mastered, 4 HP and 8 spiritual health a second. Learned by defeating 500 slimes. Evolves into Ultraspeed Regeneration.
ability.jaycee.flame_breath.desc: Hold to breathe a stream of fire: 8 damage a second (16 mastered) for 30 magicules a second.
ability.jaycee.body_armor.desc: Press to grow scale armor over every empty armor slot (5 / 10 / 8 / 5 armor, 4 toughness each). Press again with all four on to shed it. Shift + press grows a clawed gauntlet on your main hand (hits for 23, and you can block with it). Costs 50 magicules.
ability.jaycee.flame_attack_resistance.d: Reduces fire and heat damage. Learned by enduring flames; grows stronger with every hit.
ability.jaycee.flame_attack_nullificatio: Near-immunity to fire. A mastered Flame Attack Resistance becomes this at 1,000,000 EP.
ability.jaycee.fireball.desc: Hold to chant for 3 seconds (1 mastered), then release to hurl an exploding fireball: 100 magic + 30 fire damage in 3 blocks. Mastered, keep holding to the full 3 seconds for a charged one: 250 + 60 in 6 blocks. 30,000 magicules (50,000 charged).

attr.jaycee.perception.desc: Awareness of your surroundings. Longer reach.

Tridents and projectiles

Fighting with swords

attr.jaycee.magic_control.desc: Control over magicules. Skills and spells cost less mana.

Casting magic

Using aura skills
Being near powerful auras
Withstanding aura pressure
attr.jaycee.mental_fortitude.desc: Resistance of mind and soul. Reduces magic damage.
attr.jaycee.mental_fortitude.sources:
Spiritual pressure from strong beings
Resisting magic attacks
Intimidation
attr.jaycee.regeneration.desc: Natural recovery. Heal faster over time.

Natural healing

title.jaycee.evolved_one.desc: One who has overcome the limits of their first body.

race.jaycee.human.desc: A versatile and adaptable race with balanced development potential. Humans may seem ordinary, but they can grow beyond their limits through evolution, unique skills and special circumstances.
race.jaycee.human.strengths:
High adaptability and growth potential.
Balanced development across all areas.
Can evolve into higher existences (Enlightened, Saint).
race.jaycee.human.limitations:
Lower natural stats than monster races.
No innate resistances.
Relies on training, experience and skills.
race.jaycee.elf.desc: A long-lived people of the forest with a natural gift for magic and the bow. Elves see the flow of magicules more clearly than most.
race.jaycee.elf.strengths:
High magic control and mana.
Nimble and quick.
Natural talent for archery.
race.jaycee.elf.limitations:
Fragile body.
Weak physical strength.
Slow to recover from heavy wounds.
race.jaycee.dwarf.desc: Stout masters of stone and metal. Dwarves are hardy, stubborn and stronger than their size suggests.
race.jaycee.dwarf.strengths:
High strength and vitality.
Tough body.
Strong aura control.
race.jaycee.dwarf.limitations:
Slow movement.
Poor swimmers.
Limited magic talent.
race.jaycee.goblin.desc: Small, weak and quick to grow. A goblin that survives can become something far greater.
race.jaycee.goblin.strengths:
Fast early evolution.
Quick and agile.
Can branch into the Oni line.
race.jaycee.goblin.limitations:
Very weak at first.
Small body.
Low mana and aura.
race.jaycee.ogre.desc: Horned warriors of great strength. Ogres can awaken into Oni, mighty beings of spirit and battle.
race.jaycee.ogre.strengths:
Very high physical strength.
Strong aura.
Two Oni evolution paths.
race.jaycee.ogre.limitations:
Limited magic.
Large body is an easy target.
Evolving needs great power.
race.jaycee.orc.desc: Pig-headed brutes with endless hunger and endurance. In legend, an Orc Lord can grow into a disaster.
race.jaycee.orc.strengths:
High health and endurance.
Strong body.
Branching Orc Lord path.
race.jaycee.orc.limitations:
Slow and heavy.
Very low magic.
Feared and distrusted.
race.jaycee.lizardman.desc: Scaled warriors of the marshes with the blood of dragons in their veins. Their evolution leads toward the draconic.
race.jaycee.lizardman.strengths:
Tough scales and good swimming.
Born with Flame Breath.
Can evolve toward Divine Dragon.
race.jaycee.lizardman.limitations:
Weak to cold.
Average magic.
Dragon path needs great EP.
race.jaycee.halfling.desc: Small, cheerful and surprisingly lucky. Halflings are hard to notice and quick on their feet.
race.jaycee.halfling.strengths:
Agile and quick.
Good perception.
Balanced magic.
race.jaycee.halfling.limitations:
Small and weak body.
Low strength.
Limited reach.
race.jaycee.merfolk.desc: People of the sea with a fish tail. Merfolk rule the water but struggle on land until they evolve.
race.jaycee.merfolk.strengths:
Exceptional swimming and breathing underwater.
Good magic.
Strong in the sea.
race.jaycee.merfolk.limitations:
Slow on land with a tail.
Dries out on land too long.
Cannot grow legs at first.
race.jaycee.beastfolk.desc: Humanoids with the instincts of beasts. Beastfolk choose their animal path as they evolve: wolf, fox, cat, lion, rabbit or bird.
race.jaycee.beastfolk.strengths:
Fast and strong.
Keen senses.
Six beastkin branches.
race.jaycee.beastfolk.limitations:
Low magic.
Wild instincts.
Branch choice is permanent.
race.jaycee.slime.desc: The weakest of monsters, or so they say. A slime can absorb what it defeats and become something unimaginable.
race.jaycee.slime.strengths:
Very high magic potential.
No fall damage body.
Legendary evolution path.
race.jaycee.slime.limitations:
Extremely weak start.
No limbs or weapons.
Slow and small.
race.jaycee.giant.desc: Towering beings of raw strength. Giants grow ancient and, in time, divine.
race.jaycee.giant.strengths:
Huge health and strength.
Long reach.
High knockback resistance.
race.jaycee.giant.limitations:
Very slow.
Huge target.
Very low magic.
race.jaycee.insectoid.desc: A chitin-armoured insect being that thrives in swarms and evolves into the Soul and Divine Insect.
race.jaycee.insectoid.strengths:
Fast and agile.
Tough carapace.
Good perception.
race.jaycee.insectoid.limitations:
Weak to fire.
Low vitality.
Feared by most races.
race.jaycee.direwolf.desc: A wolf of the wild forest. Direwolves can become Tempest Wolves, wolves of storm and speed.
race.jaycee.direwolf.strengths:
Very fast.
Strong senses.
Pack instinct.
race.jaycee.direwolf.limitations:
Cannot use tools well.
Low magic.
Small health early.
race.jaycee.skeleton.desc: Bones bound by lingering magicules. Skeletons do not tire and can rise as Death Knights.
race.jaycee.skeleton.strengths:
No need to breathe.
Tireless.
Strong undead evolutions.
race.jaycee.skeleton.limitations:
Weak to holy power.
Fragile bones.
Healing is slow.
race.jaycee.zombie.desc: A corpse given hunger. Slow and tough, a zombie can become a Deathman and then a Death Spirit.
race.jaycee.zombie.strengths:
High health.
Hard to stop.
Poison resistant body.
race.jaycee.zombie.limitations:
Very slow.
Weak to holy power.
Low intelligence.
race.jaycee.ghoul.desc: A flesh-eating undead that can become a true Vampire if it gains enough power.
race.jaycee.ghoul.strengths:
Strong and fast.
Can become a Vampire.
Heals by feeding.
race.jaycee.ghoul.limitations:
Weak to sunlight and holy power.
Hated by the living.
Unstable body.
race.jaycee.wight.desc: An intelligent undead soul in armour. A Wight can rule as a Wight King.
race.jaycee.wight.strengths:
Good magic.
Command over lesser undead.
Strong spirit.
race.jaycee.wight.limitations:
Weak to holy power.
Fragile body.
Slow to heal.
race.jaycee.vampire.desc: An undying noble of the night. Vampires are powerful from the start but burn in the sun.
race.jaycee.vampire.strengths:
High stats across the board.
Strong regeneration at night.
Path to Divine Vampire.
race.jaycee.vampire.limitations:
Weak to sunlight.
Weak to holy power.
Hard to play early.
race.jaycee.lesser_daemon.desc: A spirit from the underworld bound to a body. Lesser Daemons rise toward Arch Daemon and Devil Lord.
race.jaycee.lesser_daemon.strengths:
High magic and aura.
Born with Flame Breath.
Path to Devil Lord.
race.jaycee.lesser_daemon.limitations:
Weak to holy power.
Unstable body.
Feared by most races.
race.jaycee.lesser_angel.desc: A spirit of light given form. Lesser Angels climb the heavenly ranks toward Seraph.
race.jaycee.lesser_angel.strengths:
Holy power.
Good magic and speed.
Path to Seraph.
race.jaycee.lesser_angel.limitations:
Weak to demonic power.
Fragile body.
Hard to grow early.
race.jaycee.elemental.desc: A living mass of elemental magicules. Elementals grow into Elemental Lords or Dryads of the forest.
race.jaycee.elemental.strengths:
Exceptional magic.
Weightless body.
Path to Dryad or Elemental Lord.
race.jaycee.elemental.limitations:
Very weak body.
Low strength.
Unstable without mana.
race.jaycee.phantom.desc: A shadow spirit that walks between life and death. Phantoms are swift, strong in spirit and hard to see.
race.jaycee.phantom.strengths:
High spirit, magic and aura.
Very fast.
Hard to detect.
race.jaycee.phantom.limitations:
Fragile body.
Weak to holy power.
Hard to play.
race.jaycee.pixie.desc: A tiny fairy spirit full of mischief and magic.
race.jaycee.pixie.strengths:
High magic.
Very quick.
Can fly as it grows.
race.jaycee.pixie.limitations:
Tiny and fragile.
Very low strength.
Easy to knock away.

jaycee.birthright.mortal_born.chat: You were born Mortal. The Mist hides the hidden world from you, for now.
jaycee.birthright.oracle_born.subtitle: The Mist is thin around you.
jaycee.birthright.oracle_born.chat: You were born Oracle-born. You will see what others cannot, but it cannot touch you yet.
jaycee.birthright.godblood.subtitle: A god's blood runs in your veins.
jaycee.birthright.godblood.chat: You were born Godblood, the distant child of a god. The hidden world sees you, and it can reach you.

ability.jaycee.great_sage.mode.refine.de: Opens the Sage's storage. Anything in it that can be smelted is refined automatically, one item every half second.
ability.jaycee.predator.mode.mimicry.des: Take the form of something you've devoured. Coming soon.
ability.jaycee.predator.mode.isolation.d: Empty hand: purge harmful effects from your target, or yourself, for 200 magicules each. Holding food: dissolve it into magicules and health.

jaycee.appraisal.correct_tool: Held tool can mine and drop it
ability.jaycee.ultraspeed_regeneration.d: Wounds close instantly: all missing health at once, for 100 magicules per HP (60 mastered). Learned with Self-Regeneration mastered, the sea's great beast defeated (Elder Guardian) and over 300,000 EP.
ability.jaycee.infinite_regeneration.des: The peak of regeneration: body and spiritual health restored instantly. Learned with Ultraspeed Regeneration and over 2,000,000 EP.
jaycee.demon_lord.seed: You have become a Demon Lord Seed. From now on, the souls of those you defeat are yours.
jaycee.demon_lord.can_awaken: You hold 10,000 souls. Begin the Harvest Festival with /jaycee harvest (at 20,000 it begins on its own).

jaycee.naming.evolve.desc: Evolves the target. 20% chance the cost comes out of your max Magicule.
jaycee.naming.endow.desc: A huge gift that grows it further. 50% chance the cost comes out of your max Magicule.

jaycee.editor.no_features: Your form has no features to shape yet.
jaycee.editor.no_features.hint: Evolving unlocks ears, tails, horns, wings and more.
ability.jaycee.coercion.desc: A roar that scares anything way weaker than you and weakens it. Shift + press (mastered) to change how much power you let out.
ability.jaycee.haki.desc: Hold to let your aura out. Everything in 15 blocks that is less than half as strong as you gets hit with Fear. You can barely move while doing it.
ability.jaycee.demon_lord_haki.desc: The demon lord version of Haki, much heavier. Coat mode wraps your attacks in haki so they hit harder.
ability.jaycee.hero_haki.desc: The holy version of Haki, golden and heavier than the normal one.
ability.jaycee.mortal_fear.desc: Your haki pours out of all your subordinates at once and powers them up. With no subordinates it just comes out of you.
ability.jaycee.strength.desc: Press for +6 attack damage for a minute (+12 for 2 minutes once mastered). Press again to drop it.
ability.jaycee.steel_strength.desc: Press for +12 attack damage for 30 seconds (+18 for 90 seconds once mastered).
ability.jaycee.strengthen_body.desc: Always on: +5 armor and you take 20% less damage.
ability.jaycee.thought_acceleration.desc: Always on: you think faster, so you move a bit faster and swing a lot faster.
ability.jaycee.paralysis.desc: While it is on your bar, your hits paralyze.
ability.jaycee.poison.desc: While it is on your bar, your hits poison.
ability.jaycee.corrosion.desc: While it is on your bar, your hits wither. Press it while holding raw meat to rot it.
ability.jaycee.ice_breath.desc: Hold to breathe ice. 8 damage a second (16 mastered) and it freezes.
ability.jaycee.thunder_breath.desc: Hold to breathe lightning. 10 damage a second (20 mastered).
ability.jaycee.poisonous_breath.desc: Hold to breathe poison. 15 damage a second (30 mastered).
ability.jaycee.paralysing_breath.desc: Hold to breathe a paralyzing gas. Paralysis III.
ability.jaycee.ultrasonic_waves.desc: A sonic blast in a line, 8 damage, leaves them dizzy.
ability.jaycee.voice_cannon.desc: Shout a blast in a line. 20 damage (30 mastered), 15 blocks (20 mastered).
ability.jaycee.water_blade.desc: Throw a slicing disc of water, 40 damage.
ability.jaycee.hydraulic_propulsion.desc: Shoot yourself forward. Only works in water or rain.
ability.jaycee.sense_heat_source.desc: Toggle: living things within 20 blocks glow for you.
ability.jaycee.universal_perception.desc: Magic Sense, heat and sound all in one. Everything within 30 blocks glows for you. 25 magicules a second.
jaycee.skill.scale.not_mastered: Master it first to hold your power back.
jaycee.skill.need_water: You need to be in water or rain.
ability.jaycee.shadow_motion.desc: Hold to melt into the shadows: invisible and fast. Only somewhere dark until you master it. Mastered, Step mode jumps you right behind whatever you look at.
ability.jaycee.ultra_instinct.desc: Toggle. Your body dodges on its own: 10% chance any hit just misses.
ability.jaycee.danger_sense.desc: Toggle. When something starts hunting you, you hear a bell from where it is.
ability.jaycee.snake_eye.desc: Hold to stare something down. It gets worse the longer you look. Modes: corrosion, poison, paralysis, petrification, insanity.
ability.jaycee.drain.desc: Bite something close for 6 damage and heal that much. No blood, no drain.
ability.jaycee.ogre_berserker.desc: Go berserk: +30 attack and +10 armor for 3 minutes (6 mastered). Costs 5,000 magicules.
ability.jaycee.scale_armor.desc: Always on: +6 armor and you swim faster.
ability.jaycee.dragon_skin.desc: Always on with no armor equipped: your skin works like armor, and gets tougher the more EP you have.
jaycee.skill.too_bright: Too bright here to hide in the shadows.
ability.jaycee.abaddon.desc: A King-class ultimate skill that embodies total destruction and catastrophic force.
ability.jaycee.ahura_mazda.desc: Lord of Virtue. Raises allies' power and shields them with sacred light, and turns hostile magic aside.
ability.jaycee.amalthea.desc: Goddess of abundance. Overflowing life that heals and empowers everyone you protect, and pours out endless resources.
ability.jaycee.amaterasu.desc: Fine mastery over mixing Light, heat, and energy in all forms into every movement, accelerating to light speed.
ability.jaycee.amon.desc: Amon, Lord of Greed is the ultimate evolved Skill of Greed. This powerful skill is capable of stealing even the Life from its victims. This is truly the manifestation of Greed
ability.jaycee.angra_mainyu.desc: Lord of Evil. Corrupts and curses everything around you, eats away at enemies' power and turns their malice back on them.
ability.jaycee.asmodeus.desc: Lust King. The ultimate form of Lust: life and death in your hands.
ability.jaycee.astaroth.desc: The evolution of Astarte and Belphegor, unified as one. Fallen Lord (Passive): the user becomes Majin, takes 15% less Holy and Spiritual damage, and gains Hand of Creation and Hand of Destruction. Phantasmal Style (In-Slot): attacks deal 2.5% of the target's spiritual health (5% mastered), may inflict Drowsiness up to level 8 (15% chance, 30% mastered), and deal +50 spiritual damage per Drowsiness level. Fallen Edge: Fallen Catastrophe kills targets meeting fewer than 2 of 3 conditions (spiritual resistance, over 30% of your EP, an ultimate skill) and makes the rest drowsy; Fallen Strike adds 2.5% spiritual health damage (5% mastered) and kills non-ultimate targets at 30% spiritual health. Fallen Slumber (Held): Fallen Thanatos spreads Drowsiness every 7 seconds and kills those at level 10; Fallen Sleep heals 100 HP and SHP a second and multiplies MP and AP regeneration 150x. Fallen World: the World of Nightmares, of Ruination, or of Creation.
ability.jaycee.astarte.desc: An ultimate skill that governs heavenly authority and divine administration.
ability.jaycee.azathoth.desc: God-class void sovereign. Commands imaginary space, void predation, multidimensional barriers, True Dragon nucleation, and nihility.
ability.jaycee.azazel.desc: Ultimate temptation — Tempt Control, All of Creation, Solicitation, Charm Domination, Severed Realm, and collapse arts.
ability.jaycee.azi_dahaka.desc: Lord of Disaster. Wears down the world itself: spreading ruin, curses and decay over a wide area.
ability.jaycee.azrael.desc: A saving authority that turns mercy into execution, sanctifies the hunted, and shields its bearer behind quiet absolution.
ability.jaycee.beelzebuth.desc: Beelzebuth, Lord of Gluttony is the ultimate evolved Skill of Gluttony. Devour all in your path
ability.jaycee.belial.desc: Ultimate underworld flame: All of Creation, spacetime, soul bank, nihilistic world, white flare, and nihility.
ability.jaycee.belphegor.desc: Sloth King. The ultimate form of Sloth: deeper sleep over a wider area, and twice the copies.
ability.jaycee.cthugha.desc: Ultimate flame charity — Spacetime Manipulation, stronger Amplification, Encore, Stockpile, Parallel Existence, Cardinal Acceleration, Multidimensional Barrier, and Scorch Excitation.
ability.jaycee.cthulhu.desc: Fusion of Gabriel and Leviathan. Envy frozen into eternity, waiting beneath the ice for all that it covets.
ability.jaycee.deus_ex_machina.desc: A chaotic Ultimate Skill that governs matter, structure, and inorganic manipulation. Grants authority over minerals, convergence of what IS to make what SHOULD NOT, and the ability to ensure dominion over the will of 'Godly Metals'.
ability.jaycee.djibril.desc: Lord of Wisdom. Thought acceleration, analysis and precise light that pierces through a single target.
ability.jaycee.faust.desc: Curiosity has always been your strong suit, learning came easy, and teaching just as much. You find yourself able to see and touch the information of the world itself.
ability.jaycee.fortuna.desc: Goddess of Fortune. Bends probability: your attacks find their mark, enemies' luck runs out, deadly blows miss you.
ability.jaycee.gabriel.desc: Ultimate fixation and stillness. What is, remains. What moves, stops. Patience outlasts everything.
ability.jaycee.hamiel.desc: Your journey for glory is over... You have succeeded. While all that you hurt, only receives half, so shall you.
ability.jaycee.haniel.desc: The Great Archangel of health blesses you with energy, you may not be able to fight, but you shall take no damage regardless.
ability.jaycee.hastur.desc: Ultimate authority over wind, sound, and star tempest. Its howl is the last thing the heavens hear.
ability.jaycee.indra.desc: Lord of Thunder. Calls down heaven's lightning, rides it at lightning speed and blasts everything in its path.
ability.jaycee.israfil.desc: Israfil is the an instrument of authority over space.
ability.jaycee.jibril.desc: Thou who has absolute control over inertia, movement, vectors, and kinetic forces. That is Jibril, the power of Rigor.
ability.jaycee.leviathan.desc: Envy Lord. The ultimate form of Envy, wider and hungrier, and harder to hit.
ability.jaycee.lucifer.desc: Pride King. The ultimate form of Pride: you can copy even ultimate skills.
ability.jaycee.mammon.desc: Greed King. The ultimate form of Greed: wills break twice as fast and a death wish needs half the time.
ability.jaycee.mephisto.desc: Lord of Contracts. Binds enemies with demonic pacts and illusions, and makes their own power answer to you.
ability.jaycee.metatron.desc: The Domination of Pure Energy, Separation of Concepts, and the Prevention of Interference.
ability.jaycee.metis.desc: Metis is the truly ruler of space itself. Not a single skill can reach its level of control.
ability.jaycee.michael.desc: Ascend the Heavenly Throne. Erase chaos, dominate minds, and execute absolute justice. You alone control the circuits, you alone are to be God! Isn't that right.... Master§
ability.jaycee.nodens.desc: Born from the collapse of Pride, forged in the void between soul and thought, Nodens is the incarnation of pure abyssal thought. This God-Class Ultimate Skill cannot be learned, only survived.
ability.jaycee.nyarlathotep.desc: When you control the chances of anything happening, nothing goes without your say, but no one can predict what that say is.
ability.jaycee.raguel.desc: Ultimate charity — upgraded Encore and Stockpile, Parallel Existence, optional Cardinal Acceleration, and Amplification with Thought Acceleration (non-stacking).
ability.jaycee.rex.desc: King of Rulers. Absolute authority: weaker beings kneel, follow your orders and cannot raise a hand against you.
ability.jaycee.samael.desc: The ultimate evolution of Deadly Poison — Death World, nihility, and absolute barrier control.
ability.jaycee.sandalphon.desc: Ultimate executioner. It moves without a sound and passes judgement without appeal.
ability.jaycee.sariel.desc: Ultimate of Unyielding — hope, backup, fortitude, and life domination.
ability.jaycee.satanael.desc: Wrath King. The ultimate form of Wrath: a bigger reactor, a deeper rampage and a rupture that levels everything around you.
ability.jaycee.sephirot.desc: Tree of Life. Connects you to the flow of all things: heal, restore, and borrow the powers of those bound to you.
ability.jaycee.shub_niggurath.desc: Harvest of every skill you have owned. Store memories, recreate lost arts, craft new ones, duplicate mastered creations, and gift analyzed skills to allies.
ability.jaycee.small_world.desc: A world of your own. Shrinks space around you into a domain where you set the rules and nothing escapes.
ability.jaycee.surya.desc: The absolute authority of Holy magic, Spiritron particles, Separation of Laws, and Dictation of Interference.
ability.jaycee.susanoo.desc: The evolved form of Chaotic Fate. Manipulate destiny, distort dimensions, and counter all harm.
ability.jaycee.terra_mater.desc: Mother Earth. Commands the ground itself: walls, quakes, crushing earth and the strength of the land.
ability.jaycee.true_hero.desc: Ultimate evolution of Chosen One. No hero who fought beside you is ever truly lost; they march on beneath your banner.
ability.jaycee.uriel.desc: Altered covenant authority over prison, barrier, cleansing and law degradation.
ability.jaycee.vayu.desc: Lord of Wind. Becomes the wind: storms, blades of air and movement faster than the eye can follow.
ability.jaycee.veldora.desc: True Dragon of Storms. The tempest has a will of its own, and it is loud.
ability.jaycee.velgrynd.desc: True Dragon of Scorch. Her love burns as fiercely as her wrath.
ability.jaycee.yaoyorozu.desc: A shrine-maiden ultimate born from Analyst and Manufacturer, allowing the user to imitate magic, guide craft and analysis, and fuse technique into a perfected synthesis.
ability.jaycee.yog_sothoth.desc: Ultimate spacetime lord — coating, usurpation, prison, and time itself.
ability.jaycee.yog_sotohort.desc: The supreme God of Time and Space—use Yog-Sothoth's composite data of Courage, Justice, and Hope to ascend. Usurp the powers of Yog-Sothoth, Sariel, Michael, and Azazel. Manifest Absolute Authority, Courage, Justice, and Hope.
ability.jaycee.agastya.desc: Lord of the Sea. Commands water at a scale no one else can, drowning and crushing whatever stands against you.
ability.jaycee.agni.desc: Ultimate blaze charity — Flame Authority, Blast Blow, Blazeball, Maximum Blazeball, and Blaze Wave.
ability.jaycee.alternative.desc: Proxy rights granted under Michael. Seven modes of absolute superiority.
ability.jaycee.melchizedek.desc: King of Salvation. Holy power that heals allies, purifies curses and burns away the undead.
ability.jaycee.multiple_weapons.desc: Every weapon at once. Conjures and wields countless blades that strike from all directions.
ability.jaycee.orpheus.desc: Lord of Songs. Music that soothes, charms or kills: your melody reaches the soul of everything that hears it.
ability.jaycee.world_map.desc: The evolved form of Traveler. Dominate space itself, cross any distance in an instant, rain stardust on your foes and chart the whole world.
ability.jaycee.artist.desc: The ultimate evolution of Imitator. Act any target including ultimates, battlewills, and magics. Imprint disguise onto stage crew. Open the Gallery to acquire any learned skill.
ability.jaycee.bahamut.desc: Dragon King. The full might of a true dragon: dragon breath, dragon scales and overwhelming draconic haki.
ability.jaycee.beelzebub.desc: Beelzebuth, Lord of Gluttony. Everything Gluttony has at ultimate strength, plus soul devouring, a black hole of darkness and the power to steal souls outright.
ability.jaycee.blade_transformation.desc: Turns your body into a blade: every part of you cuts, and nothing can block your edge.
ability.jaycee.eternal.desc: Never fades. Your body and soul are kept eternal: you don't age, decay or fall, and recover from anything.
ability.jaycee.grimoire.desc: Grimoire is the Book of Magic, an Ultimate Gift which allows one the access to truly master all of Magic
ability.jaycee.immortal.desc: Cannot die. Wounds close as soon as they open, and even a fatal blow fails to end you.
ability.jaycee.mood_maker.desc: Manipulate the moods and fate of yourself and others — twist luck, defy death, and amplify your spirit.
ability.jaycee.necronomicon.desc: A forbidden tome of godlike duality and dominion over death, the final evolution of Holy Demonic Inversion. Its pages remember every soul they have claimed.
ability.jaycee.proserpina.desc: Queen of the Underworld. Commands the dead and the souls of the fallen, and drags the living down to join them.
ability.jaycee.tsukuyomi.desc: Lord of the Moon. Moonlight illusions and a night that steals the senses, freezing enemies in a dream.
ability.jaycee.absolute_end.desc: Brings everything to its end: a strike that ends whatever it touches, a field where nothing survives.
ability.jaycee.adapter.desc: Adapts to anything. Grows resistant to whatever hurts you and evolves in the middle of a fight.
ability.jaycee.all_rounder.desc: Good at everything. Strikes, shots and guards that adapt to whatever the situation needs.
ability.jaycee.analyst.desc: Enhance cognitive processing, analyze targets and phenomena, accelerate magic casting and deepen understanding of the laws of the world to optimize all actions.
ability.jaycee.avenger.desc: Vengeance made power. Remembers every wound and returns it many times over.
ability.jaycee.awakener.desc: Awakens hidden potential in yourself and your allies, pushing them past their limits.
ability.jaycee.berserk.desc: Massively empower your body and infuse it with a flame aura. Allows you to go into a risky but overwhelmingly powerful berserker mode.
ability.jaycee.berserker.desc: Feed on your enemies' defeat. Gain EP from kills, destroy equipment faster, and boost your physical stats based on your power level.
ability.jaycee.bewilder.desc: Manipulate friends and foes, compelling them to act according to your will.
ability.jaycee.carnation.desc: After taking in the power of those around you to the point of gluttonous overconsumption. You absorb energy just as you did before, with your limits on uniques refreshed. Your growth fuels everyone.
ability.jaycee.chef.desc: Purify and renew. Remove all negative effects and restore vitality to those under your care.
ability.jaycee.chosen_one.desc: Radiate authority and charisma to force fear into the hearts of your enemies and to make them follow you instead, while empowering yourself and your allies.
ability.jaycee.combatant.desc: Born to fight. Heightened instincts, flowing combos and an unbreakable guard.
ability.jaycee.commander.desc: Lead the charge with your allies. Empower yourself and your allies to give yourself an overwhelming advantage.
ability.jaycee.cook.desc: Bend reality to ensure your enemies meet their demise by ignoring their dodge and barriers.
ability.jaycee.craftsman.desc: Master artisan. Creates weapons and tools of exceptional quality and reinforces what you already have.
ability.jaycee.creator: Creator
ability.jaycee.creator.desc: Create any Unique Skill and use it for a limited amount of time.
ability.jaycee.decipherer.desc: Decipherer &6is a unique-skill capable of seeing ones circulation of Magicules.
ability.jaycee.degenerate.desc: Craft, decraft, customize items and absorb strength from weakened enemies.
ability.jaycee.dilettante.desc: A taste of everything. Picks up other people's techniques by watching and copies them, a little weaker.
ability.jaycee.divine_berserker.desc: Empower your body by a massive amount but beware the aftereffects.
ability.jaycee.eminence.desc: An overwhelming presence. Others shrink from you, obey your orders and feel safe at your side.
ability.jaycee.engorger.desc: Increase your size and boost your physical stats.
ability.jaycee.falsifier.desc: See through falsehoods and invisibility, conceal your presence from prying eyes and create illusions.
ability.jaycee.fusionist.desc: Turn the world into a weapon, absorb the environment to create powerful mines and grenades.
ability.jaycee.give_me_strength.desc: Borrows the strength of those around you and pours it all into one decisive moment.
ability.jaycee.glutton.desc: An endless appetite. Gobbles things up, digests them into health and stores what you eat.
ability.jaycee.gluttony.desc: Absorb all in your path. None can win. Receive and provide skills, gain access to a spatial storage and mimic entities.
ability.jaycee.gourmand.desc: Feast on the energy of your opponents. Steal magicule with your attacks and become more powerful when killing others.
ability.jaycee.gourmet.desc: Absorb your enemies, gain new powers, and break down anything that stands in your way.
ability.jaycee.greed.desc: The sin of greed. Want everything: wills, power, skills, even lives.
ability.jaycee.guardian.desc: Stand as a bastion against the force of your enemies. Absorb the damage from your allies and fortify their defenses.
ability.jaycee.guide.desc: Shows the way. Leads allies with perfect instructions, revealing paths, danger and weak points.
ability.jaycee.healer.desc: Mend wounds with a touch or unleash devastating afflictions, capable of both salvation and suffering.
ability.jaycee.imitator.desc: Learn others through observation, then wear their face, stats, and skills. Imprint your disguise onto loyal clones as sentient stage crew.
ability.jaycee.infinity_prison.desc: Trap enemies in an unbreakable dimensional cage or shield yourself from any threat with your dimensional barrier. Gain access to spatial storage.
ability.jaycee.intruder.desc: Slips past any defence: through barriers, walls and locks, straight to where you want to be.
ability.jaycee.investigator.desc: In pursuit of all that interests you, there are many things to find, be it danger, treasure, students, or more.
ability.jaycee.leader.desc: Master your subordinates: assign them to jobs, organize them into groups, delegate tasks to entire groups, and designate each group's work center and stockpile.
ability.jaycee.looter.desc: Takes what isn't yours: steals items, energy and even skills from those you defeat.
ability.jaycee.lord_of_magewolves.desc: Command a growing magewolf pack and enhance your abilities with their own.
ability.jaycee.lust.desc: The sin of lust. Power over life and desire: drain, heal, embrace, bless with death, and bend wills.
ability.jaycee.manipulator.desc: A smiling divinity beyond the world's edge, unseen by ordinary perception and gifted at turning trust, names and mortal desire into invisible chains.
ability.jaycee.manufacturer.desc: Separate, transmute, and rebuild known spells into named modified submodes.
ability.jaycee.martial_master.desc: Empower your physical attacks, accelerate your thought process to react and dodge better while beating your enemies to submission.
ability.jaycee.mathematician.desc: Use mathematics to improve your combat abilities, become able to use analytical appraisal to assess all.
ability.jaycee.megalomania.desc: Delusions of grandeur made real. The more you believe in yourself, the stronger you become.
ability.jaycee.merciless.desc: Instantly kill weakened enemies or drain the life force of those who lack the will to fight or of those much weaker than you.
ability.jaycee.milim_ear.desc: Milim's hearing. Catches every sound for miles: footsteps, whispers, heartbeats.
ability.jaycee.milim_eye.desc: Milim's sight. Sees through lies, illusions and hidden things, and sees an enemy's true strength.
ability.jaycee.motherly_queen.desc: A mother's protection. Shields and heals everyone under your care, and grows fierce when they're threatened.
ability.jaycee.murderer.desc: Disappear into the shadows and deal massive damage, also become undetectable by sound.
ability.jaycee.musician.desc: Turn beautiful music into an instrument of destruction. Use sound to create powerful blasts which ignore armor.
ability.jaycee.observer.desc: See all, evade all. Instinctively avoid attacks, detect concealed dangers, and identify hidden entities. Nothing escapes your watchful gaze.
ability.jaycee.oppressor.desc: Dominate gravity yourself, control attractive and repulsive forces or unleash devastating ranged attacks which will crush anyone unfortunate enough to be in your path.
ability.jaycee.optimist.desc: Everything will work out. Bad luck slides off you and good fortune follows you.
ability.jaycee.overcomer.desc: Overcomes every hardship. The worse things get, the stronger and tougher you become.
ability.jaycee.paranoia.desc: Trusts nothing. Senses every threat before it arrives and reacts before it lands.
ability.jaycee.perceiver.desc: Perceives everything around you: presence, magicules and intentions, with nowhere left to hide.
ability.jaycee.planner.desc: Plans for everything. Predicts how a fight will go and sets traps that spring at the right moment.
ability.jaycee.pride.desc: The sin of pride. Everything beneath you is beneath you: skills that hit you become yours, the weak are crushed by your presence.
ability.jaycee.reaper.desc: Do recon by becoming smaller and more agile while seeing all enemies nearby. Spawn clones, or consume the essence of your enemies to obliterate them in a single strike.
ability.jaycee.recorder.desc: Records everything you see perfectly, then recalls and replays it: techniques, places, spells.
ability.jaycee.reflector.desc: Turn back the tides of battle by reflecting all of the received damage. Unleash a devastating projectile attack or counter an attack directly.
ability.jaycee.regressor.desc: Turns back time on a body: wounds undone, a moment rewound, a mistake erased.
ability.jaycee.researcher.desc: Study ancient magic tomes, reverse engineer them, and create wonders beyond imagination.
ability.jaycee.responder.desc: Answers every attack. Counters automatically, turning an enemy's strike back on them.
ability.jaycee.reverser.desc: Flip the rules. Change alignments, invert buffs and debuffs while shifting strengths and weaknesses to your benefit.
ability.jaycee.royal_beast_form.desc: The form of a royal beast. Transforms into a mighty beast with raw strength, speed and a roar that cows the weak.
ability.jaycee.scavenger.desc: This Unique Skill is a Predation ability with further developed capabilities, allowing one to even predate items, armor and gear.
ability.jaycee.seeker.desc: Accelerate thought processing to extreme levels, mastery over magics and manipulate the fundamental laws governing the world to optimize actions and outcomes.
ability.jaycee.seer.desc: See everything. Foresee your opponent’s moves. Dodge or mitigate their attacks and predict their movement to score critical strikes.
ability.jaycee.sentient_being.desc: Born from the magicules of your peers, your growth depends on them and theirs depends on you. You are naturally more attuned to the absorption of energy from the environment.
ability.jaycee.severer.desc: Slice through reality and manifest spatial blades which cut through armor and unleash devastating blade storms.
ability.jaycee.shadow_striker.desc: Become one with the shadows and deal massive spiritual damage and become immune to lesser presence detection.
ability.jaycee.sloth.desc: The sin of sloth. Sleep, rest and letting others do the work: hypnosis, drowsiness, soul strikes and copies of yourself.
ability.jaycee.sniper.desc: Deal damage from afar while using different bullets to get past resistances and ensure a quick kill.
ability.jaycee.spearhead.desc: Empower and command your allies, and then collect their abilities once they pass on.
ability.jaycee.spiral_body.desc: A body that spirals. Twisting, drilling strikes that bore through armour, and a body that turns blows aside.
ability.jaycee.starved.desc: Consume all in your path or have your rampaging subordinates do it. Corrode your enemies, devour their strength, and adding their abilities to your own.
ability.jaycee.supporter.desc: Made to back others up. Strengthens, heals and protects your allies from behind.
ability.jaycee.suppressor.desc: Restrict teleportation, confuse enemies by swapping places, and use your blink as well as the spatial gate to cross large distances.
ability.jaycee.survivor.desc: Endure and outheal anything, resist physical and natural damage and withstand overwhelming odds.
ability.jaycee.tempter.desc: Unique temptation — Charm, Temptation World, Reality Exchange, Solicitation, and End of World.
ability.jaycee.thrower.desc: Use your skill and your precision to throw anything and deal massive damage. You can even shove air or push back your foes.
ability.jaycee.time_traveler.desc: Bend causality — auto-save your state, cheat death, and rewind the battlefield.
ability.jaycee.tough_guy.desc: Just too tough. Shrugs off hits that would fell anyone else.
ability.jaycee.traveler.desc: Move freely through space, teleport large distances or create spatial gates. Manipulate stardust to immense damage.
ability.jaycee.tuner.desc: Change your fate survive fatal blows, regenerate instantly and manipulate probability.
ability.jaycee.tyrant.desc: Tyrant &6is a unique-skill capable of invading peoples minds, and ensuring your success in combat through mental invasion and the breaking of one's will.
ability.jaycee.unyielding.desc: Draw power from loyal allies. Fortify subordinates and seamlessly switch to a backup body to stay in the fight.
ability.jaycee.usurper.desc: Seize your enemies' power or their summons. Steal their abilities and take control of their skills, draining their strength for your own.
ability.jaycee.villain.desc: Embody malice and fight on the side of evil. Gain increased power from killing your foes, manipulate your enemies into joining your side and empower your allies.
ability.jaycee.voracious_resurrection.de: Eats to come back. Devours life around you to heal, and to rise again from death.
ability.jaycee.wisher.desc: Wishes come true, at a price. Grants a wish for power, healing or protection.
ability.jaycee.limiter.desc: Sets limits. Caps an enemy's power, speed or skills, and lifts your own limits when you need it.
ability.jaycee.all_of_creation.desc: Everything that exists. Creates and shapes matter, life and energy as you will.
ability.jaycee.all_seeing_eye.desc: Go into a 3rd person mode, with your increased POV you gain movement and action buffs as well as an upgrade to Presence Sense.
ability.jaycee.analytical_appraisal.desc: Assess the strength of your opponents to gain insight into their overall strength.
ability.jaycee.appraisal_eye.desc: Looks at something and knows what it is: its stats, skills and weaknesses.
ability.jaycee.armor_fusion.desc: Fuses armour into your body, becoming far harder to hurt.
ability.jaycee.black_flame.desc: Command the tempest infused flames to spew out black flames at your enemies or even shoot deadly fireballs and hell flares.
ability.jaycee.black_lightning.desc: Shoot black lightning at varying strength, or summon a massive storm which attacks any non-allied mobs. A short range plasma blast can also be used to melt even the strongest of foes.
ability.jaycee.black_thunder.desc: Black lightning that tears through defences, far stronger than ordinary thunder.
ability.jaycee.body_double.desc: Use a tenth of your magical power to summon an identical clone which takes increased damage but will fight for you until the end. The user can exchange places with the clone but risk taking increased damage.
ability.jaycee.celestial_eye.desc: Sees from above, the whole battlefield at once, including what's hidden.
ability.jaycee.chant_annulment.desc: Become able to cast mastered magic instantly, in water or even under the effects of silence.
ability.jaycee.charm.desc: Use your inherent power to turn your opponents neutral or to temporarily dominate weak opponents.
ability.jaycee.danger_detection.desc: Warns you of danger before it strikes.
ability.jaycee.demon_lord_s_haki.desc: The haki of a demon lord. Weaker beings are paralysed with fear and your attacks carry overwhelming pressure.
ability.jaycee.divine_strength.desc: Strength on the level of a god: your bare blows hit like siege weapons and send enemies flying.
ability.jaycee.earth_manipulation.desc: Boosts the power of Earth abilities by a decent amount.
ability.jaycee.enhanced_body_double.desc: Makes a strengthened copy of yourself that fights alongside you.
ability.jaycee.explosive_flames.desc: Flames packed so tight they burst on contact, blowing apart whatever they touch.
ability.jaycee.flame_domination.desc: Boosts the power of fire abilities by a large amount.
ability.jaycee.flame_manipulation.desc: Boosts the power of fire abilities by a decent amount.
ability.jaycee.frenzy.desc: Goes berserk: much stronger and faster, but you lose some control.
ability.jaycee.full_body_armorize.desc: Covers your whole body in hardened armour.
ability.jaycee.fusion.desc: Become one with a contracted Spirit Lord through Spirit Union: its element strikes 1.5x harder and inflicts its nature on those you hit, its element harms you 75% less, and a killing blow ends the Union instead of your life.
You have already seen this blow land. That is exactly why it will not.
ability.jaycee.godwolf_sense.desc: Improve your senses to be able to see in the dark or even spot invisible entities nearby.
ability.jaycee.gravity_domination.desc: Boosts Gravity abilities by a large amount and allows you to fly without hindrance.
ability.jaycee.gravity_manipulation.desc: Boosts Gravity abilities by a decent amount and allows you to fly without hindrance.
ability.jaycee.heat_source_perception.de: Senses heat, so living things show up even through walls and in the dark.
ability.jaycee.heat_wave.desc: Shoot a fiery projectile or summon a short-ranged fire storm which will damage all nearby entities.
ability.jaycee.heavenly_eye.desc: Project your otherworldly gaze to see all nearby entities and partially ignore dodging abilities.
ability.jaycee.hero_s_haki.desc: The haki of a hero. Allies take heart and evil things falter before you.
ability.jaycee.holy_haki.desc: Sacred pressure that terrifies demons and the undead and burns them.
ability.jaycee.holy_demonic_inversion.de: The ability to flip the coin and get the desired side.
ability.jaycee.immovable.desc: Can't be moved: no knockback, no being pushed or pulled.
ability.jaycee.iron_wall.desc: An iron wall of defence that blocks attacks head-on.
ability.jaycee.law_domination.desc: "To understand the laws of the world is one thing. To bend them is another, but what is the limit of my ability to dominate it?"
ability.jaycee.law_manipulation.desc: Bypass many restrictions by manipulating the law of the world.
ability.jaycee.life_domination.desc: Commands life itself: heals allies, saps enemies and controls living things.
ability.jaycee.life_drain.desc: Drains life from enemies to heal yourself.
ability.jaycee.magic_aura.desc: Empower your attacks with many elemental aura.
ability.jaycee.magic_flame_transformatio: Turns your body into magical flame, immune to normal attacks and burning what touches you.
ability.jaycee.majesty.desc: By boosting your reputation with the villagers, gain a permanent Hero of the Village effect.
ability.jaycee.malice_perception.desc: Senses ill intent aimed at you.
ability.jaycee.mana_jamming.desc: Jams the magicules around you, disrupting enemy spells.
ability.jaycee.mana_manipulation.desc: Grant better control on Mana with less magicule cost on casted Magics and less damage taken from magicule-based attacks.
ability.jaycee.mana_perception.desc: Sees magicules: the flow of magic and hidden presences.
ability.jaycee.metal_manipulation.desc: Bends and shapes metal: weapons, armour and blades.
ability.jaycee.molecular_manipulation.de: Use your intricate knowledge and power over the building blocks of the world to obtain blocks and move entities.
Create a layered barrier that unites the properties of the Multilayer Barrier Skill and Fault Field.
ability.jaycee.multilayer_barrier.desc: Protect yourself with a multitude of powerful defensive barriers.
ability.jaycee.observing_eye.desc: Watches everything in detail: movements, tells and openings.
ability.jaycee.parallel_calculation.desc: Runs many calculations at once, speeding up spells and thought.
ability.jaycee.parallel_existence.desc: Exists in more than one place at once: a second body that acts independently.
ability.jaycee.parallel_thought.desc: Thinks several thoughts at once, juggling spells and actions.
ability.jaycee.perfect_memory.desc: Nothing you see or hear is ever lost. Spells and techniques you've seen once can be recalled perfectly.
ability.jaycee.predictive_calculation.de: Calculates what happens next and dodges before it arrives.
ability.jaycee.presence_detection.desc: Senses the presence of everything around you.
ability.jaycee.quantum_manipulation.desc: Manipulates matter at its smallest level: break it apart, put it back together.
ability.jaycee.ranged_barrier.desc: Place down differently sized barriers which block enemies in or out. Strong attacks can still destroy them.
ability.jaycee.sage.desc: Increase the speed at which you learn and master skills, magic and arts.
ability.jaycee.sound_wave_perception.des: Senses through sound waves, mapping everything around you.
ability.jaycee.spacetime_domination.desc: An upgraded spacetime package requiring mastered Spatial Domination and a compatible ultimate. Grants Spacetime Infliction, Warp Shot, Dimension Ray, Dimension Storm, Fault Field, Space-Time Cleanse, Spatial Transfer, and a learnable local Time Stop.
ability.jaycee.spacetime_manipulation.de: A spacetime package that supersedes Spatial Domination. Inflict devastating spatial damage, warp reality, and move through space at will.
ability.jaycee.spatial_domination.desc: Boosts Space abilities by a large amount and deals massive damage by splitting a target with dimensional attacks.
ability.jaycee.spatial_manipulation.desc: Boosts Space abilities by a decent amount and manipulate space to empower your ranged attacks.
ability.jaycee.spatial_motion.desc: Tear space asunder granting yourself and your allies safe passage.
ability.jaycee.spatial_storage.desc: Rift space to create a small pocket dimension to store items.
ability.jaycee.spiritual_domination.desc: Dominates the spirit, bending a target's will to yours.
ability.jaycee.spiritual_manipulation.de: Reaches into the spirit to manipulate a target's will and feelings.
ability.jaycee.temporal_manipulation.des: Bends time: slows enemies, speeds yourself.
ability.jaycee.thought_domination.desc: Takes over a target's thoughts completely.
ability.jaycee.thought_manipulation.desc: Plants thoughts in a target's head and steers what they do.
ability.jaycee.ultra_acceleration.desc: Speeds your mind up so the world crawls.
ability.jaycee.ultra_intuition.desc: Intuition so sharp it's almost foresight.
ability.jaycee.ultra_recovery.desc: Your body knits itself back together at an unnatural pace, closing wounds in moments.
ability.jaycee.ultra_sense.desc: All your senses sharpened at once.
ability.jaycee.ultra_smell.desc: Smells things from far away, even what's hidden.
ability.jaycee.ultra_sound_waves.desc: Blasts sound waves that stun and shatter.
ability.jaycee.ultra_vibration.desc: Vibrations that shake apart whatever you strike.
ability.jaycee.ultraspeed_action.desc: Your body keeps up with your thoughts: you move and strike at speeds others can't follow.
ability.jaycee.ultraspeed_reaction.desc: Reacts at ultra speed, dodging what you'd never normally see.
ability.jaycee.ultraspeed_thought.desc: Your mind runs a thousand times faster, giving you time to read and answer any attack.
ability.jaycee.universal_shapeshift.desc: A mastered form of Mimicry that grants full control over one's shape and presence.
ability.jaycee.water_manipulation.desc: Boosts Water abilities by a decent amount.
ability.jaycee.weather_domination.desc: Use magicule to manipulate the weather with a higher efficiency.
ability.jaycee.weather_manipulation.desc: Use magicule to manipulate the weather.
ability.jaycee.wind_manipulation.desc: Boosts Wind abilities by a decent amount.
ability.jaycee.farsight.desc: Focus your eyes and become able to see things far away.
ability.jaycee.paralyzing_breath.desc: Breathes a mist that paralyses whatever it touches.
